product_one_liner.value: Smallest.ai provides low-latency speech models and voice agents for enterprises to automate support, sales, collections, and scheduling.

employee_band.notes: A 2026 company announcement reports nearly 60 employees; this is not a live headcount.

eng_blog.notes: Technical posts cover Lightning V2 inference co-design on Tenstorrent and Lightning V3 streaming synthesis, authored respectively by an inference engineer and the speech-model R&D team.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation covers voice agents, speech models, SDKs, and API endpoints.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Speech Research Scientist—Bangalore; the posting provides an application link.

model_provider.value: Smallest AI (Electron, Lightning, Pulse, Hydra) and OpenAI (GPT-4o, GPT-4.1, GPT Realtime, GPT Realtime Mini).
model_provider.notes: The speech models and Electron are developed in-house; the voice-agent documentation also lists selectable OpenAI models.

compliance_certs.notes: These are public claims. The trust center lists SOC 2 Type II, but marks its report expired in August 2026; the website still claims SOC 2 compliance.

last_funding.notes: Announced July 30, 2026. The $21 million headline refers to cumulative funding, not the Series A round amount.

raised_18mo.notes: The $13 million Series A announced July 30, 2026 falls within the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Business Development Representative (BDR)—GTM & Outbound—US, in San Francisco; the posting provides an Apply link.

launched_6mo.notes: The Lightning V3 announcement is dated October 5, 2026 and states that the model is available.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Siddharth Sharma's appointment as President–BFSI, India was announced November 6, 2026; counted as president-level senior leadership, rather than an exact C-level or VP title.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Named under “Tools You'll Likely Use” in its BDR posting; Zoho is explicitly labeled CRM.
